jobs_results.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs_results.description: Location: Tampa, FL Employment type: Full-time, on-site Pay: $130,000 - $140,000 per year, commensurate with experience Schedule: Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., with scheduled call-in coverage for planned shutdowns and critical downtime events, compensated at time-and-a-half Job description SolidMark Technologies manufactures engineered polymer and composite components at our Tampa facility, where fifteen lines produce parts for aerospace, medical device, and industrial equipment customers under AS9100 and ISO 13485 quality systems. We are hiring a Senior Automation Engineer to own the facility's control systems end to end: Allen-Bradley PLCs, the Ignition SCADA platform, robotic material handling, and in-line vision inspection. Responsibilities Program, commission, and troubleshoot Allen-Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix platforms across fifteen packaging and processing lines Administer and extend the Ignition SCADA platform, including alarm rationalization, historian configuration, and tag architecture Direct capital automation projects from scope definition and vendor evaluation through factory acceptance testing, installation, and validation Integrate, calibrate, and support robotic palletizing equipment, case packers, and Cognex vision inspection systems Design and document plant-floor network architecture, including Stratix switch configuration, VLAN segmentation, and CIP Security readiness Mentor controls engineering staff and review all contractor-developed code prior to production deployment Maintain control system documentation for FDA and SQF audit requirements Analyze recurring failure modes through downtime root cause analysis and report findings monthly to plant leadership Qualifications Required: Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, industrial engineering, mechatronics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience with relevant certification Five or more years of controls and automation experience in manufacturing, including at least two years of independent ownership of a production area Proficiency programming Allen-Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix systems in Studio 5000 Hands-on SCADA administration experience; Ignition preferred, FactoryTalk or Wonderware accepted Working knowledge of industrial networking, including EtherNet/IP, device-level ring topology, and managed switch configuration Experience with variable frequency drives, servo motion control, and vision-guided robotic systems Ability to lift up to 35 pounds, access mezzanine levels via stairs and ladders, and perform troubleshooting in refrigerated production areas, with or without reasonable accommodation Preferred: Ignition Perspective or Core developer certification Safety certification covering control of hazardous energy and robot safety per ANSI/RIA R15.06 Experience preparing control system documentation for FDA or SQF audits Working proficiency in C#, Python, or SQL for reporting and historian data analysis Benefits Medical, dental, and vision coverage effective on the date of hire Company-paid life insurance and short-term disability 401(k) plan with a 4 percent company match, fully vested upon enrollment Fifteen days of paid time off and nine paid holidays annually Annual professional development allowance of $4,000 for certifications, training, and conferences Tuition reimbursement for ABET or SACS-accredited degree completion programs On-site employee parking at no cost Apply Today Apply through this job posting. A recruiter will contact you within five business days if your qualifications match the position. About SolidMark Technologies SolidMark Technologies operates a 210,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Tampa, employing approximately 340 people in production, engineering, and quality roles. Equal opportunity employer SolidMark Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: This role focuses on designing, developing, implementing, and optimizing automation control systems for industrial processes and highly automated warehouse distribution equipment
You will work with conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply systems, SCADA devices, and related material handling equipment to improve reliability, performance, and safety

You will serve as a technical expert on automation controls, lead complex troubleshooting, and drive continuous improvement initiatives while strictly following established policies, procedures, and safety standards
Serve as the on-site technical expert for automation control systems, providing guidance and mentoring to less experienced automation engineers to ensure adherence to safety and technical standards
Design, develop, implement, and optimize control systems and software for industrial automation and material handling equipment
Program, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot PLC and PC-based controllers, HMI systems, and industrial control networks
Support and optimize material handling equipment (MHE) including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply systems, and SCADA devices
Adhere to strict documentation requirements and follow Automation Change Management procedures for all system modifications and upgrades
Partner closely with operations, engineering, and support teams to deliver automation projects and improve MHE performance and reliability
Monitor MHE metrics and KPIs, analyze performance issues, and lead troubleshooting efforts both locally on-site and remotely
Conduct root cause analysis for equipment and system failures, implement corrective actions, and drive process improvements for performance and cost savings
Communicate technical issues, project timelines, risks, and operational workarounds clearly to leadership and key stakeholders
Provide remote technical support for automation systems, guiding teams through diagnostics, error resolution, and system recovery
Interpret, modify, and develop mechanical and electrical drawings to support installation, maintenance, and upgrades of automation systems
Use CMMS tools to plan, coordinate, and document complex maintenance activities involving multiple stakeholders
Support field service engineering and technical training activities related to conveyors, sortation, ASRS, industrial robotics, and other automation equipment
Engage in continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging data and system performance metrics to identify opportunities for optimization
Work flexibly across varied 10-hour shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support a high-speed, highly automated distribution environment
You will work in a large, highly automated distribution facility equipped with high-speed material handling systems and extensive robotic components
The role is physically active and requires comfort with walking approximately 10,000 steps per day as you move throughout the facility to support equipment and systems
All positions operate on 10-hour shifts, and you must be open to working any shift, including days, nights, weekends, and holidays, to support continuous operations

You will regularly interact with advanced automation technologies, including conveyors, sortation equipment, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply systems, PLCs, HMIs, SCADA devices, and industrial electrical and control systems

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you! Job Summary We're looking for a motivated Software Development Engineer I with an interest in AI and machine learning to join our growing AI engineering team. In this role, you will work across a portfolio of AI initiatives, helping take them from prototype and proof of concept to production systems the business can rely on. The work spans applied LLM and agent systems, intelligent automation of engineering workflows, and modeling and simulation of complex systems, and the mix shifts as new opportunities come in. This is a role for someone who is comfortable with variety, picks up unfamiliar domains quickly, and wants to build depth in production AI systems. Familiarity with Confluent Kafka, Google Cloud, and BigQuery is important to this role, and you'll be supported in growing that expertise. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, data scientists, ML engineers, product managers, and infrastructure teams to bring cutting-edge innovations to production at scale.Responsibilities  Contribute to the development and productionalization of AI-driven systems and services across multiple initiatives, under the guidance of senior engineers. Help build and maintain streaming and batch data pipelines using Confluent Kafka and stream processing tooling such as Flink and Kafka Streams. Write and maintain queries and datasets in BigQuery that support AI workloads and reporting. Build and maintain APIs and microservices that support AI workloads. Support agent, tool-calling, and retrieval integrations so AI systems can query authoritative internal systems and return grounded, verifiable answers. Follow AI best practices related to ethical AI, responsible data handling, and evaluation of AI output quality. Document the systems you work on so they are supportable by the wider team. Continuously build your skills in AI/ML and modern data engineering practices. jobs_results.description:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon's business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there's more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will serve as the site expert for maintaining the automation systems that are critical for operations
- You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
- You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
- You will provide first-level escalation support for site technicians, both locally and remotely 
- You will perform and analyze building System Assessments to enhance material handling system performance 



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of Ladder Logic and structured programming from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Codesys PLCs experience
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS- Experience with HMI and control network components, including maintenance, troubleshooting, programming and design
- Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
- Experience with preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls, and industrial electronics & robotics
- Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
- Experience programming with RSLogix5000, Studio 5000, FT View, and other controls software platforms
